entries.title: Lección Primera
journal: The first lesson begins with animals, size and direct questions. The aim is to let the repeated Spanish and the original illustrations establish meaning before reaching for an English explanation.
This entry remains preliminary until the complete first-reading, handwriting, spoken-answer, conversation and second-reading cycle has been completed.
entries.todaySpanish: El elefante es un animal. ¿Qué es el elefante? Es un animal.
